title: American Music Awards: Winners List (Updating Live)
summary: The Queen Latifah-hosted show, airing live on CBS from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, features performances from lifetime achievement award recipient Billy Idol, Pussycat Dolls and Busta Rhymes, KATSEYE and New Kids on the Block and a special live appearance from BTS, their first at an awards show in four years.
